title: Project Khaos
features:
🎯 Aimbot
Aimbot – lock‑on target with FOV circle

Trigger Bot – auto‑fires when locked on

Anti‑Recoil – compensates recoil

Hitbox Extender – multiplier slider to enlarge hitboxes

Prediction – lead moving targets (adjustable time)

Lock Strength – slider to control aim smoothness

🏃 Movement
Speed Hack – custom WalkSpeed (16–500)

Click Teleport – teleport to mouse click location

Low Gravity – reduce workspace gravity

Bunny Hop – auto‑jump while moving

Strafe Bot – automatic side‑to‑side movement when locked on

Noclip – walk through walls

Fly – free flight (WASD + Space/Shift)

Infinite Jump – jump repeatedly in the air

Jetpack – hold Space to boost upward

⚔️ Combat
Rapid Fire – faster shooting

Infinite Ammo – never run out

Spin Bot – rotate your character (adjustable speed)

Kill Aura – attack enemies within a custom range

Auto Reload – reload automatically when empty

Quick Switch – swap to secondary weapon on empty

Auto Execute – finish downed players

Auto W+S – follow a selected player (forward/backward bounce)

👁️ ESP & Visuals
ESP Master – toggle all ESP elements

2D Boxes – rectangles around enemies

Skeleton – lines connecting body parts

Tracers – lines from screen center to enemies

Chams – glowing outline/highlight on enemies

Weapon ESP – display enemy’s equipped tool

Health Text – show exact HP

Distance Rainbow – colour changes with distance

Radar – minimap showing nearby players

ESP Color Panel – pick from 10 preset colours or clear

🧪 Experimental
Lag Switch – freeze character periodically (adjustable delay)

Ghost Mode – make yourself locally invisible

A‑Train – sprint forward with high speed

⚙️ Utility
Third Person – toggle third‑person camera

FOV Unlock – change field of view

Freecam – detach camera and fly around

Auto Clicker – spam left‑click at custom CPS

Time Control – change in‑game time of day

Anti‑AFK – auto‑jump to prevent idle kicks

Auto Respawn – instantly respawn after death

Lag Optimizer – periodic memory cleanup🔐 Key System                                                                    
Compact, draggable key panel with Discord invite copy button

Key panel can be minimized or closed

🛡️ Always Active
Anti‑Cheat Bypass – simulates ground contact, smooths speed, clamps velocity, normalises jump power to avoid fly/speed/jump detections

Watermark – small “Project Khaos v4.0” badge (visible after unlock)

⌨️ Keybinds
Every feature has a 🔑 button to assign a custom keyboard shortcut

Mouse buttons and the X key are blocked from binds to prevent accidental toggles    (just want to say I AM NOT RESPONSIBLE IF YOU GET BANNED USING THIS SCRIPT)
